meta.name: agent-team
meta.description: 产品经理与项目管理专家在应对复杂项目时，使用此技能可动态组建包含“执行、指挥、评审”的专属AI团队。实时查看多智能体辩论与决策全过程，共享统一上下文记忆，一键完成从会议决策到系统构建的全流程高效协同！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组建AI团队协同处理复杂项目，实时查看多智能体决策过程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要多智能体协助管理复杂项目、决策与执行。
copy.tagline_en: Build an AI team to handle complex projects, watch multi-agent decisions live
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent assistance in managing complex, decision-heavy projects.

howto.what: Claude 会组建由执行、指挥、评审三类角色组成的 AI 智能体团队,按串行、并行、循环或混合流程协同完成任务,并展示各智能体发言、辩论与形成共识的过程,共享同一套上下文记忆和决策历史。
howto.when: 当需要多个智能体协同完成复杂任务,或需要为特定场景管理一组智能体时触发,例如技术架构决策、OPC 系统构建、产品定价等场景。

say.text: 请用技术决策团队评估微服务架构的可行性
say.note: 会看到主持人引导、各角色发言辩论直到形成共识

say.text: 请用 OPC 团队构建 AI 短视频领域的系统
say.note: 战略分析、产品架构、自动化工程三个智能体按顺序输出

say.text: 请用产品团队制定这款产品的定价策略
say.note: 市场分析师与财务顾问辩论后给出定价结论

howto.what_en: Claude assembles an AI team of execution, command, and review roles, then runs the task in serial, parallel, loop, or mixed flows. You see the agents speak, debate, and reach consensus, sharing one context memory and decision history.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a task needs several agents working together, or when you want a managed agent group for a scenario such as architecture decisions, OPC system building, or product pricing.

say_en.text: Use the tech decision team to assess a microservices architecture.
say_en.note: You see the host and agents debate until consensus.

say_en.text: Use the OPC team to build a system for AI short video.
say_en.note: Strategy, product, and engineering agents run in order.

say_en.text: Use the product team to set pricing for this product.
say_en.note: Market and finance agents debate, then conclude.
